title: The still-life breather

members.role: the held plate is the whole world of the beat - no page, no chart, one room the three species live in
steam lifts off the cup on the held plate - the first of three things moving on a scene with no chart
the ticker's rows flicker on the paper beside it, 0.2 s later
a trace draws across the third corner, so no region of the plate is still
the breather ends by collapsing into a point, spinning, and the argument resumes

does: The beat between two arguments: no chart, one plate, and three still-life species alive in three corners of it for six seconds before the world is sucked away.
